name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery Gutenberg bulk-order workflow with WooCommerce and ASE Supplier Sync compatibility.
changelog:
1.1.1

  • Mobile expanded products no longer repeat the large hero image.
  • Mobile keeps one product accordion open at a time to reduce excessive scrolling.
  • The per-piece pricing matrix now fits within the mobile viewport without horizontal swiping.
  • Mobile spacing, tier messaging, typography, and decoration controls were tightened for faster progression.
  • Desktop behavior and Supplier Sync compatibility are unchanged.
